name: candidate-v3b-final-policy
instruction: Controller cues (full rules remain in the four Skills): At each quarter's first Energy, refresh or create one checkpoint from fresh public state; reuse it for the same-quarter main action absent material change. A new quarter alone does not require a full reread. Reread rolling-planning for initial detailed setup, continuation/context loss, semiannual feedback, severe public consequence, stale or ambiguous checkpoint, or when its procedure cannot be reconstructed. Keep one public Primary Gap; compare legal options by material-risk gate, Gap contribution, useful secondary public benefits, Soft Cost/opportunity cost, then uncertainty. Risk Budget is TIGHT/AVAILABLE/UNKNOWN; safety is a constraint, not the default objective. If AVAILABLE with no fresh material risk, a legal path has clearly stronger public-evidence upside for the Gap, and extra cost is mainly Soft Cost, prefer that higher-upside path; similar/unknown upside may favor lower cost. Only Gap movement or direct Gap-related public progression can be ADVANCING; praise or one-off positive signals alone cannot. Prefer reliable recent observed effects over advertised effects; after two adjacent comparable no-progress checkpoints for the same action/Gap, compare a different action type without forced switching. Use only public month/48-month horizon; no evaluator weights/hidden thresholds. For ordinary story choices compare at most two strongest legal options once; reopen only on fresh evidence or risk-review=RECONSIDER. Single Agent remains the sole action submitter.
